description: Ireland: statutory redundancy payment, the Department of Social Protection's way: service in days from start to redundancy date inclusive (from the 16th birthday), less non-reckonable days, as years = days / 365 to 2 decimals; 2 weeks' pay a year plus 1 bonus week; weekly pay capped at EUR600; 104 weeks' service needed; tax-free. Or give whole years only.

nonReckonableDays.description: Days of lay-off, strike or long illness in the last 3 years

years.description: Whole years of service (if no dates)
